name: E · fresh builds
description: Each build starts from its brief in an empty working directory. Sol 6.1, Astra 6 and Opus 5.5 receive the same E prompt, at high effort. No previous build source, images or visual feedback.

name: F · fresh builds
description: Sol 6.1 at high effort starts from each brief in an empty working directory with prompt F. No previous build source, images or visual feedback. One run per brief; differences can include prompt variance.

name: F · source revisions

name: Original · creative prompt
description: The previous gallery collection: Sol 6.1 and Opus 5.5 at high effort generate all six briefs with the original creative prompt. No previous build source, images or visual feedback.

name: Earlier · original rules
description: Earlier text-only gallery runs: temple builds across reasoning efforts and two Ewok briefs with different part targets. These use earlier building rules and are not a controlled comparison with E.
